rules.name: AHU Supply Air Temperature Persistent Deviation
rules.description: Target AHUs serving tenant areas on office buildings. While an AHU is ON, open a Critical issue when absolute difference between supply-air temperature and its setpoint is greater than 3°C continuously for 15 minutes.

rules.name: High Indoor CO2 Concentration Alert
rules.description: Monitors indoor air quality in occupied rooms. Flags when CO2 exceeds 1000 ppm threshold for more than 10 minutes.

rules.name: Floor Electricity Meter Excessive Power Spike
rules.description: Detects abnormal power consumption when floor active power exceeds 120 kW continuous baseline.

rules.name: AHU Abnormal High Return Air Temperature
rules.description: Detects inadequate cooling where return air temperature exceeds 28°C.
